name: Lighting Transfer Function with Gradient Aligned Sampling
definition: A volume rendering technique that enhances material boundaries by using two scalar samples taken along the normalized gradient direction (one in the gradient direction, one opposite) as inputs to a 2D lighting transfer function, while the center sample is used for color/opacity.
summary: Lighting Transfer Function with Gradient Aligned Sampling is a non-photorealistic volume rendering technique that enhances material boundaries by using two scalar samples along the normalized gradient direction to dynamically adjust lighting coefficients based on local data structure.
